gc_triggering_call.description: call that can allocate memory and trigger an emergency garbage collection

gc_anchor.description: function/macro that roots a GC object on the Lua stack before a GC-triggering call

weakly_referenced_object.description: local variable holding the GC object (table) that may be weakly referenced and is updated after a GC-triggering call

weak_reference_lookup.description: retrieves a metamethod value from a possibly weak metatable

use_after_free_site.description: operations that access the object after the GC-triggering call
